hooks.command: if command -v anti-slop-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then anti-slop-hook --harness antigravity --stdin-tool-json; elif [ -f ../gates/hooks/run_diff_gate_hook.py ]; then python3 -B ../gates/hooks/run_diff_gate_hook.py --harness antigravity --stdin-tool-json; else uvx --from git+https://github.com/jremick/anti-slop anti-slop-hook --harness antigravity --stdin-tool-json; fi

Stop.command: if command -v anti-slop-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then anti-slop-hook --harness antigravity --no-budget; elif [ -f ../gates/hooks/run_diff_gate_hook.py ]; then python3 -B ../gates/hooks/run_diff_gate_hook.py --harness antigravity --no-budget; else uvx --from git+https://github.com/jremick/anti-slop anti-slop-hook --harness antigravity --no-budget; fi
